_comment: Per-slug OAuth endpoints for Pipedream apps the importer can't get from the repo (Pipedream brokers OAuth, so authorize_url/token_url/scopes live on their platform, not in components/). Fill from each provider's own OAuth docs, then: import-pipedream <dir> --overlay pipedream.overlay.example.json. Any ProviderSpec field is accepted here (e.g. token_path, token_auth_style).
